description: This file defines a parser for Kivy language files (.kv), including classes for parsing rules, properties, exceptions, and selectors, as well as handling directives and file inclusion. It is used to interpret and process Kivy UI language syntax into internal representations.

classes.name: ProxyApp
classes.description: A proxy class for the current running Kivy application, allowing attribute access and method calls to be forwarded to the app instance.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: Custom exception raised for errors encountered during parsing of .kv files.

classes.name: ParserRuleProperty
classes.description: Represents a property within a Kivy language rule, including precompilation logic and dependency tracking.

classes.name: ParserRule
classes.description: Represents a parsed rule or widget definition from a .kv file, including methods for building, precompiling, and managing child rules.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main parser class for interpreting Kivy language files, handling directives, comments, indentation, rules, and selectors.

classes.name: ParserSelector
classes.description: Base class for widget selectors used to match widgets based on class or name.

classes.name: ParserSelectorClass
classes.description: Selector that matches widgets based on their class.

classes.name: ParserSelectorName
classes.description: Selector that matches widgets based on their name or rule name, with support for inheritance.

methods.name: precompile
methods.description: Prepares rules and properties for execution by compiling expressions.

methods.name: create_missing
methods.description: Creates properties on a widget if they are missing, based on the rule.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a widget matches the selector.

methods.name: get_bases
methods.description: Recursively retrieves base classes of a widget class for matching.

methods.name: match_rule_name
methods.description: Checks if a rule name matches the selector's key.
